notes: Owner's decision 2026-10-11 (docs/decisions/2026-10-11-when-stylebro-goes-stable.md): 1.0 ships after two clean trials in a row, first-run trials on new kinds of repository with no high-severity bugs; external users aren't required. Tally: 0 in a row after trial 33 (2026-10-19; owner: "Not clean"): `bro format` left taglib-sharp's and Scriban's files with a lone CR out, still said "Clean" (exit 0, `bro check` too), and the TreatWarningsAsErrors build failed on them; with xunit.analyzers 1.24+ (Tmds.DBus) format said Clean where check said Not clean (its fixes have no Fix All from 1.24 on); BRO1405 left a query's clauses misaligned, so Ix.NET needed a second run; all fixed. The runtime-style run (Tmds.DBus, `init --style microsoft --write`) matched its baseline. Before: 0 in a row after trial 32 (2026-10-18; owner: "Not clean"): init's end_of_line = lf converted RazorLight's CRLF test files, whose multi-line verbatim strings then held LF, and two rendering tests failed; format skipped two CAP samples in its net10.0 run (transitive references), needed a second run in Pinta (BRO1132 with K&R braces, BRO1504 with tab_width 8), and migrate re-indented ControlzEx's case blocks; all fixed. Trial 33 must include a dotnet/runtime-style repository run with `bro init --style microsoft` (owner's decision 2026-10-18, "Lens in trial 33"): the Microsoft style (backlog 075, docs/styles.md) has never been trialed on code that follows the runtime's conventions. Before: 0 in a row after trial 31 (2026-10-18; owner: "Not clean"): init marked Hangfire's whole repository as vendored code (a GPL COPYING next to its own LICENSE.md), so StyleBro would have formatted nothing there, and the renames changed 8 Avalonia property registration fields in Ursa.Avalonia (AVP1022); both fixed. Before: 1 clean in a row after trial 30 (2026-10-18; owner: "Count it clean"): Chell, rwmt/Multiplayer, QuestPDF and AvaloniaVisualBasic6 converged in one run with builds and tests as on the untouched code; the one bug (format stopped at the restore on Android/iOS/Browser heads without their workloads) changed nothing and is fixed. Before: 0 after trial 29 (Harmony's patch parameters and listed private fields renamed, Moq's build broke on a file format skipped next to a T4 template).
